title: Outdoor Cured Jamaican Pork Custard
description: A fermented and tender monsoon Jamaican dish featuring vanilla custard and cure, friendly to low sodium diets
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Fahrenheit
In a small bowl, mix together the black pepper, allspice, and thyme
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork shoulder
Place the pork shoulder in a large ziplock bag and add the scotch bonnet peppers
Seal the bag and refrigerate for 24 hours to allow the pork to cure
After 24 hours, remove the pork from the bag and rinse off the cure mixture
In a large Dutch oven, combine the heavy cream, vanilla extract, and eggs
Add the cured pork shoulder to the Dutch oven and cover with a lid
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and bake for 6 hours
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and let it cool to room temperature
Refrigerate the custard overnight and serve chilled
